key_insight: AR post-training weight updates can be reused to improve diffusion language models, and combining AR and diffusion updates can further boost performance.
engineering_relevance: A2D offers a training-free way to transfer existing post-training gains into diffusion LLMs, reducing retraining cost while improving instruction following, reasoning, and coding.
method: Add AR post-training weights directly to a diffusion base model after AR-to-diffusion conversion.
Compose AR and diffusion post-training weights to retain benefits from both update types.
Apply the same framework across supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning updates with no extra inference-time compute.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains across multiple dLLMs, including Dream, DreamReasoner, DiffuCoder, Dream-Coder, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion, and DiffusionGemma, on instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and coding.
watch_item: Weight composition may depend on how well the AR and diffusion checkpoints are aligned, so practical transfer quality could vary across model families and training setups.
paper_title: Enhancing Diffusion Language Models with Autoregressive Post-Training Weights
